collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a young adult)

collection.description: A young villager has woven shells into their hair and fears what people will say: ask a friend, or hide it under a wrap.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has done something new with (subject.his/her) hair: braided, with shells woven in. It looked wonderful in the reflection in the water. Now (subject.he/she) has to walk across the whole village to the fire, where everybody will see it, and (subject.he/she) is suddenly terrified that they'll stare, or laugh, or say something. (friend) is waiting outside.

choices.label: Pull It Back Under a Wrap

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) hides the braids under a cloth wrap and goes to the fire. Nobody notices anything. That's a relief. It's also a little disappointing. On the way home, (subject.he/she) pulls the wrap off and walks back through the dark with the shells clicking softly. Nobody sees. Tomorrow, maybe.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Is it silly?" asks (subject). (friend) looks properly. "It's lovely," (friend.he/she) says. "Different. Lovely." They walk over together. A few people look. One person says, "Oh, that's nice!" Nobody laughs. (subject) spends the whole evening feeling very aware of (subject.his/her) hair and secretly delighted.
